ApplyForStreamAccessToken.description_en: Retrieves the connection information for streaming calls
ApplyForStreamAccessToken.description_zh: 获取流式调用的连接信息

Associate.description_en: Suggests FAQs from the knowledge base based on a user query
Associate.description_zh: 根据用户query联想知识库中的FAQ

CancelChat.description_en: Cancels or interrupts a specified conversation

CancelInstancePublishTask.description_en: Cancels a chatbot publish task during the publishing process
CancelInstancePublishTask.description_zh: 在发布机器人的过程中，取消机器人发布任务

CancelPublishTask.description_en: Cancels a publish task that is in progress
CancelPublishTask.description_zh: 取消正在发布中的任务

Chat.description_en: Initiates a conversation with a chatbot by using the unique chatbot identifier (chatbot ID). This operation is applicable only to Chatbot (legacy)
Chat.description_zh: 根据机器人唯一标识（机器人ID）与其进行会话，仅适用于智能对话机器人（旧版）

ContinueInstancePublishTask.description_en: Ignores alerts and continues publishing when the chatbot triggers a publish alert
ContinueInstancePublishTask.description_zh: 机器人发布告警时，忽略告警并继续发布

CreateConnQuestion.description_en: Adds associated knowledge to a knowledge entry

CreateDSEntity.description_en: Creates an entity, specifically the meta information of the entity, such as the entity name and entity type
CreateDSEntity.description_zh: 创建实体，特指实体的Meta信息，如：实体名称、实体类型

CreateDSEntityValue.description_en: Adds entity member information for a specified entity, including the entity value and the corresponding synonym list. Entity values and synonyms must be unique within the same entity
CreateDSEntityValue.description_zh: 为指定的某个实体，添加实体成员信息，包含：实体值、对应的同义词列表，同一实体内部的实体值、同义词唯一

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates a chatbot in a sandbox environment

CreateInstancePublishTask.description_en: Publishes a sandbox chatbot to the production environment
CreateInstancePublishTask.description_zh: 将沙箱机器人发布到线上

CreateIntent.description_en: Creates an intent. The intent includes meta information such as the intent name, intent alias, and associated slot information, but does not include intent utterances or LGF
CreateIntent.description_zh: 新建意图，主要包含意图的meta信息，如：意图名称、意图别名、意图关联词槽信息；不包含意图话术、LGF

CreateLgf.description_en: Creates an advanced semantic configuration (LGF) for a specified intent
CreateLgf.description_zh: 为指定意图创建高级语义配置（LGF）

CreatePublishTask.description_en: Creates a publish task in the publish center
CreatePublishTask.description_zh: 创建发布中心的发布任务

CreateUserSay.description_en: Adds utterance information to a specified intent
CreateUserSay.description_zh: 为指定意图添加话术的信息

DeleteCategory.description_en: Deletes a category. A published category changes to the deleted and unpublished state, while an unpublished category is deleted directly
DeleteCategory.description_zh: 删除类目， 已发布的类目变成已删除未发布状态，未发布的类目则直接删除

DeleteConnQuestion.description_en: Deletes the associated knowledge of a knowledge item

DeleteDSEntity.description_en: Deletes an entity. This operation cascade deletes all entity members, synonyms, and regular expressions under the entity
DeleteDSEntity.description_zh: 删除一个实体，会级联删除该实体下所有的实体成员及同义词、正则表达式

DeleteDSEntityValue.description_en: Deletes a member of a specified entity. If the entity is a standard entity, the synonyms of the member are also deleted, if any
DeleteDSEntityValue.description_zh: 删除某个实体的某个成员；若为标准实体，会同步删除其同义词（若有）

DeleteInstance.description_en: Deletes a chatbot from both the sandbox and production environments
DeleteInstance.description_zh: 删除沙箱和线上的机器人

DeleteIntent.description_en: Deletes an intent and cascade deletes all intent utterances and advanced semantic configurations (LGF) under the intent
DeleteIntent.description_zh: 删除一个意图，会级联删除该意图下所有的意图话术和高级语义配置（LGF）

DeleteLgf.description_en: Deletes a specified advanced semantic configuration
DeleteLgf.description_zh: 删除指定高级语义配置

DeleteUserSay.description_en: Modifies the utterance information of an intent

DescribeCategory.description_en: Queries the information of a single category

DescribeDSEntity.description_en: Queries the metadata of a specified entity under a specified chatbot, such as entity type, entity name, creation time, and modification time
DescribeDSEntity.description_zh: 查询指定机器人下指定实体的meta信息，如：实体类型、实体名称、创建时间、修改时间等

DescribeDoc.description_en: Queries the details of a document

DescribeFaq.description_en: Queries the details of a knowledge entry

DescribeInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a chatbot

DescribeIntent.description_en: Returns the metadata of a specified intent, such as the intent type, intent name, creation time, and modification time
DescribeIntent.description_zh: 返回指定意图的 meta 信息，如：意图类型、意图名称、创建时间、修改时间等

DescribePerspective.description_en: Queries the details of a perspective

Feedback.description_en: Saves user feedback on Q&A results
Feedback.description_zh: 保存用户对于问答结果的评价

GenerateUserAccessToken.description_en: Retrieves a token for passwordless logon in the chat window, which carries the enterprise identity of the user
GenerateUserAccessToken.description_zh: 用于聊天窗用户免登时，获取Token，通过该Token可将用户的企业身份带入

GetAsyncResult.description_en: Retrieves the result of an asynchronous service execution. This operation is used together with the Chat operation
GetAsyncResult.description_zh: 获取异步服务执行结果，配合Chat接口使用

GetBotSessionData.description_en: Queries the overview metrics of chatbot Q&A
GetBotSessionData.description_zh: 查询机器⼈问答概览指标

GetInstancePublishTaskState.description_en: Queries the publish progress of a chatbot

InitIMConnect.description_en: Initializes an IM connection with custom settings by using the from value generated from the channel backend configuration. Supports passing a user authentication token during initialization
InitIMConnect.description_zh: 通过渠道后台配置生成的from值，自定义初始化im连接信息，初始化时支持传递用户鉴权token

LinkInstanceCategory.description_en: Associates knowledge categories with a chatbot

ListAgent.description_en: Retrieves the list of business spaces for the current Alibaba Cloud account
ListAgent.description_zh: 获取当前阿里云账号的业务空间列表

ListConnQuestion.description_en: Queries the list of associated questions for a knowledge item
ListConnQuestion.description_zh: 查询知识的关联问题列表

ListDSEntity.description_en: Queries the list of entities under a specified chatbot. Only the metadata of each entity is returned, such as entity type, entity name, creation time, and modification time
ListDSEntity.description_zh: 查询指定机器人下的实体列表数据，仅返回每个实体的meta信息，如：实体类型、实体名称、创建时间、修改时间等

ListDSEntityValue.description_en: Queries the list and details of entity members for a specified entity. Keyword filtering (contains) is supported. The filtering scope includes entity values and synonyms
ListDSEntityValue.description_zh: 查询指定实体的实体成员列表及详情数据，同时支持关键词筛选（contains），筛选范围：实体值、同义词

ListIntent.description_en: Queries the list of intents under a specified chatbot. Only the metadata of each intent is returned, such as the intent type, intent name, creation time, and modification time
ListIntent.description_zh: 查询指定机器人下的意图列表数据，仅返回每个意图的 meta 信息，如：意图类型、意图名称、创建时间、修改时间等

ListLgf.description_en: Queries the advanced semantic configuration (LGF) of a specified intent
ListLgf.description_zh: 查询指定意图的高级语义配置（LGF）

ListSaasInfo.description_en: Retrieves the list of SaaS integration information

ListSaasPermissionGroupInfos.description_en: Retrieves the list of permission integration information. You can use the permission groups returned in this list to grant permissions to users
ListSaasPermissionGroupInfos.description_zh: 获取权限被集成信息列表，可通过该列表返回的权限组，给用户授权

ListSimQuestion.description_en: Queries the list of similar questions for a knowledge entry
ListSimQuestion.description_zh: 查询知识的相似问题列表

ListSolution.description_en: Queries the list of answers for a knowledge item

ListTongyiConversationLogs.description_en: Queries the conversation records of a single session for Chatbot Tongyi Edition
ListTongyiConversationLogs.description_zh: 查询对话机器人通义版的单个会话对话记录

ListUserSay.description_en: Queries the utterance content and associated slot information of a specified intent. Supports filtering utterances by keyword (contains)
ListUserSay.description_zh: 查询指定意图的话术内容及关联槽位信息，支持关键话术筛选（contains）

Nlu.description_en: Returns the natural language understanding (NLU) result of a chatbot for a user query. Currently, only NLU information from dialog flow and the central controller is supported. Other engines will be supported as needed
Nlu.description_zh: 针对用户query，返回机器人有关这个query的语言理解（nlu）结果。当前只支持对话工厂、中控的NLU信息透出，其他引擎后续按需支持

TongyiChatDebugInfo.description_en: Retrieves the debugging information for large language model Q&A

UpdateDSEntity.description_en: Modifies the meta information of an entity. Only the entity name can be modified. The entity type cannot be modified
UpdateDSEntity.description_zh: 实体meta信息修改，仅支持修改实体名称；实体类型不支持修改

UpdateDSEntityValue.description_en: Modifies a member of a specified entity. Two types of data can be modified: entity values with synonyms, and regular expressions. Note: Adding a regular expression to a standard entity is not allowed, and vice versa
UpdateDSEntityValue.description_zh: 修改某个实体的某个实体成员，有实体值&同义词、正则表达式两类数据修改。注意：往一个标准实体中添加正则表达式是不被允许的，反之亦然

UpdateInstance.description_en: Updates the name and description of a chatbot

UpdateIntent.description_en: Modifies an intent, including the meta information of the intent, such as the intent name, intent alias, and slot information associated with the intent. This operation does not include intent utterances or LGF
UpdateIntent.description_zh: 修改意图，主要包含意图的meta信息，如：意图名称、意图别名、意图关联词槽信息；不包含意图话术、LGF

UpdateLgf.description_en: Creates an advanced semantic configuration (LGF) for a specified intent
UpdateLgf.description_zh: 为指定意图创建高级语义配置（LGF）

UpdatePerspective.description_en: Updates the name and description of a perspective

UpdateUserSay.description_en: Modifies the utterance information of an intent
